title: Write every per-case @covers tag as a full acc:{wagon}:{ACCEPTANCE-ID} URN

facts.note: REQUIRED (AND). A file run by Bun's test runner: established from repository configuration (bunfig.toml, a `bun test` script) or from `bun:test` imports, or from the set of files the bun_tester_discipline_detector scans. No filename gate: name patterns such as *.test.* / *.spec.* (any extension, incl. .jsx/.mjs/.cjs) are only a non-exhaustive discovery hint; any Bun test file containing a per-case `// @covers` block is in scope regardless of its name or directory.

REQUIRED (AND). A `// @covers` comment block directly above an it()/test() exists in, is added to, or is edited in that file; pre-existing unchanged tags count. Needs a comment-block observer tied to it()/test() calls.
Not a separate gate: implied by file_kind=bun-test-file. Not derived from paths, since custom Bun test layouts may not be path-identifiable.

NOT a prerequisite. Alternative trigger (OR) that forces a fix of an existing malformed tag, and the verification signal in evidence[0]. The guidance applies while writing well-formed tags too, when no finding exists. Combination: fires = (file_kind AND change) OR finding.

fires: Adding a `// @covers` comment above an it()/test() in a Bun test file, whatever the file is named.
Editing an existing `// @covers` tag, e.g. adding a second acceptance URN to the same line.
A pre-existing, unchanged `// @covers E005-UNIT-001` in a Bun test file is reported by the detector; it must be fixed even though the diff did not touch it.
A tag names an ID that corresponds to no genuine acceptance; its shape is still validated.
doesNotFire: An it()/test() case with no `@covers` tag at all; the file header binding still applies.
Editing only the file-level acceptance header (governed by the binding-declared convention).
Checking whether a well-formed URN resolves to an acceptance under `plan/`; that is a graph-level concern.
Test files not run by Bun (no Bun config or `bun test` script, no `bun:test` import, not scanned by the detector).

given: A Bun test case (it()/test()) has a `// @covers` comment block directly above it, binding that ONE case (not the file) to acceptances
when: the tester writes, edits, or encounters (existing, unchanged) any such tag
then: Every tag in the block MUST be a full URN `acc:{wagon}:{ACCEPTANCE-ID}` (e.g. `// @covers acc:orders:E005-UNIT-001`), never a bare ID like `// @covers E005-UNIT-001`.
prefer: Before tagging: identify the acceptance this exact case exercises, confirm its stimulus reaches that behavior, and that a behavioral assertion witnesses the declared outcome.
Several URNs on one line only when one case genuinely proves several acceptances.
Per-case tags plus the file header (two-level binding): many cases to one acceptance without one acceptance per file.
avoid: Bare/partial IDs missing the `acc:` scheme or wagon.
Valid URNs added for coverage credit when the case does not exercise and assert them; fiction the detector cannot catch.
unless: The case has no `@covers` tag: none is required; the file header binding still applies.
why: A malformed tag is strict because it binds nothing while looking exactly like a working binding; tags are semantic claims too, so precision needs them well-formed and true.
evidence: bun_tester_discipline_detector reports no malformed `@covers` tag in the scanned Bun test files (all existing tags, not only changed ones).

Reviewer confirms each tagged case's stimulus reaches the named acceptance behavior and at least one behavioral assertion witnesses its declared outcome (semantic truth is outside the detector's static reach).
verifier_detail: Collect the `// @covers` comment block immediately above each `it()` / `test()` and validate every tag in it (multiple tags per line allowed) against `acc:{wagon}:{ACCEPTANCE-ID}`; scan all existing tags, not only changed lines.
Only the tag's SHAPE is validated; resolving the URN against `plan/` is a graph-level concern, not this detector's.
Cases without any `@covers` tag produce no finding.
A well-formed but semantically false tag is outside the detector's static reach; guidance (prefer/avoid) must prevent that gaming.
Disposition strict, severity 3: any malformed tag fails; strict because a malformed tag binds nothing while looking to a reviewer like a working binding.

File scope: every Bun test file (from Bun configuration, `bun test` scripts, `bun:test` imports, or the detector's scanned set); filename patterns are a non-exhaustive hint, never a gate. Layer is implied by Bun test context, not inferred from paths.
audit: schema_version 1.1.0; kind rule; status active; introduced_in 0.1.0.
Original name: 'Per-case @covers tags are well-formed acceptance URNs'.

Bun realization of the core obligation `tester.coverage.every-acceptance-criterion-must`; stack-neutral obligation, Bun-specific detector implementing the two-level binding model. Core carries no shared alias, so lineage is stated here.
Terms: covers_tag = `// @covers acc:…` above an `it()`, binding one CASE rather than the file; two_level_binding = file header plus per-case tags.
Design rationale: 'The two-level model is the point'; argued for in design issue #1783; it is the reason a real 65-spec suite can adopt ATDD without a rename.
Disposition strict: atdd-bun fails on every finding; no advisory mode, no ratchet baseline.

splitSuggestion.then: A `@covers` tag names only acceptances whose behavior the case directly exercises and whose outcome it asserts; no tags added for coverage credit.

sharedNodes.text: strict: the detector fails on every finding; there is no advisory mode and no ratchet baseline.

additions.text: The semantic-truth obligation (tag only acceptances the case exercises and asserts) is independent of the shape obligation and should be its own convention (tester.covers-tag-semantically-true); kept here in prefer/avoid/evidence so nothing is lost.

Activation combination (file_kind AND change) OR finding; filename patterns demoted to a non-exhaustive hint; layer implied by Bun test context; doesNotFire items about header-only edits, non-Bun and non-test files; fires item about pre-existing unchanged tags.
additions.justification: Auditor feedback: the source validates every per-case tag in any Bun test file, so activation must not be narrowed by filenames, paths, or by requiring a finding.

additions.text: File scope determined from Bun configuration, `bun test` scripts, `bun:test` imports or the detector's scanned set rather than filename extension or path.
additions.justification: Needed for honest, non-narrowing activation; extension/path alone does not establish Bun or the test layer.

additions.text: Reviewer-based semantic check as an evidence item.
additions.justification: Source says the detector cannot catch semantically false tags and guidance must prevent it; a review step is the only way to establish that compliance.
